    Fabric's EditAuthority: the automation actor is Fabric API's native FakePlayer with the shared AutomationActor profile, and removal answers to Fabric API's block-break event, the counterpart to Forge's block-break event, so claim and protection mods can veto automation-driven removal the same way they can on Forge.
    FabricStackInteractionEvents
